NOTE: Do NOT manually edit this file. This file is automatically updated when semantic release (release.yml) runs. Manually editing this file can break your releases and break third party tools that use this file.

patches.name: Allow screen recording
patches.description: Clears FLAG_SECURE and disables secure surfaces so the app can be screen-recorded.

patches.name: Allow screenshots
patches.description: Clears FLAG_SECURE from window flags so the app can be captured in screenshots.

patches.name: Allow text selection
patches.description: Flips setTextIsSelectable(false)/setLongClickable(false) to true so text can be selected and copied.

patches.name: Bypass root / emulator detection
patches.description: Forces common root and emulator detection methods to report clean. Covers Java/Kotlin-level checks; native (.so) detection is not affected.

patches.name: Change package name
patches.description: Renames the app package (appends ".lustx" by default) and updates custom permissions and content-provider authorities. Changing the package name can break apps that hardcode their package or authorities in code.

options.title: Package name
options.description: New package name. "Default" appends ".lustx" to the original.

options.title: Update permissions
options.description: Rename custom permissions (incl. the dynamic-receiver permission) that use the old package.

options.title: Update provider authorities
options.description: Rename content-provider authorities that use the old package.

patches.name: Change version name / code
patches.description: Rewrites the manifest versionName/versionCode and the baked-in BuildConfig values. 'Current' keeps the existing value.

options.title: Version name
options.description: New android:versionName (e.g. 9.9.9), or 'Current'.

options.title: Version code
options.description: New android:versionCode (digits), or 'Current'.

patches.name: Custom font
patches.description: Overrides the app's typeface with a built-in font family. Affects explicit Typeface usage; views that never set a typeface keep the system default.

options.title: Font family
options.description: The built-in font family to apply.

patches.name: Disable boot start-up
patches.description: Prevents the app from auto-starting on device boot by removing boot intent-filter actions and the RECEIVE_BOOT_COMPLETED permission.

options.title: Also block update start-up
options.description: Also remove MY_PACKAGE_REPLACED (auto-start after the app is updated).

patches.name: Force dark / AMOLED theme
patches.description: Forces AppCompat night mode to YES and (optionally) flips AMOLED/pure-black flags. Covers AppCompat/Material apps; Jetpack Compose themes are not affected.

options.title: Enable AMOLED / pure-black
options.description: Also force isPureBlack/isAmoled-style flags to true (best-effort).

patches.name: Forced-update bypass
patches.description: Neuters in-app forced-update gates (dialogs, blocking checks, version prompts). Works on apps that keep readable method names; fully-obfuscated apps need per-app fingerprints.

patches.name: Hide app icon
patches.description: Hides the app from the launcher by replacing the LAUNCHER category with DEFAULT. The app stays installed; launch it via another app or a shortcut.

patches.name: Remove PairIP
patches.description: Removes the PairIP Play licensing gate (startup license check, response validation, repeated checks and paywall/kill path). Does not bypass PairIP native virtualization or Play Integrity attestation.

patches.name: Remove rate-us / review prompts
patches.description: Suppresses in-app rating/review dialogs and gates. Optionally blocks the Play Core system review dialog (may crash apps that don't null-check the returned Task).

options.title: Block Play Core review dialog
options.description: No-ops ReviewManager.requestReviewFlow/launchReviewFlow. Off by default: some apps NPE on the null Task. Enable only if you see the system dialog.

patches.name: Rename app label
patches.description: Sets a literal launcher name on <application>, launcher activities and aliases. 'Current' keeps the existing label.

options.title: App label
options.description: New display name shown in the launcher, or 'Current'.

patches.name: Skip splash
patches.description: Skips splash/intro screens by running their deferred navigation immediately and removing artificial sleeps. Scoped to splash-named Activity/Fragment classes.

options.title: Convert splash delays to immediate
options.description: Replaces postDelayed/sleep inside splash classes with immediate execution. If a splash blanks or hangs, disable this.

patches.name: Spoof device identity
patches.description: Unified device spoofing with per-category toggles: Android ID, MAC address, SIM/carrier, and Build device fields. Includes emulator presets. Replaces the former individual SpoofAndroidId, SpoofSim, and SpoofDevice patches.

options.title: Spoof Android ID
options.description: Overrides Settings.Secure 'android_id' reads.

options.title: Android ID value
options.description: 16 hex chars, or 'Random' to generate one per build.

options.title: Spoof MAC address
options.description: Overrides WifiInfo.getMacAddress() and BluetoothAdapter.getAddress().

options.title: MAC address value
options.description: Format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF, or 'Random'.

options.title: Spoof SIM / carrier
options.description: Overrides TelephonyManager and SubscriptionInfo country/operator getters.

options.title: SIM preset
options.description: The simulated SIM/network identity.

options.title: Spoof device / Build fields
options.description: Overrides Build device identity fields using read-site patching. Includes emulator presets.

options.title: Device preset
options.description: Target device identity.

options.title: Also spoof OS version
options.description: Also spoof Build.VERSION RELEASE, SDK_INT, SECURITY_PATCH, INCREMENTAL. Can break apps; off by default.

patches.name: Spoof install source
patches.description: Makes the app believe it was installed from a chosen store (Play Store by default).

options.title: Install source
options.description: The installer package to report.

patches.name: Spoof rooted environment
patches.description: Makes Java-level root checks report rooted: forces detection methods to return true and overrides Build.TAGS/USER/HOST. For testing bypass patches (e.g. PortDroid). Native detection is not affected.

options.title: Override Build fields
options.description: Sets TAGS=test-keys, USER=root, HOST=buildbot in Build.<clinit>.

patches.name: Strip VPN checks
patches.description: Hides an active VPN from the app by neutralizing NetworkCapabilities transport/capability checks and (optionally) network-interface name checks.

options.title: Also strip interface-name checks
options.description: Defeat tun/ppp/tap interface-name comparisons in NetworkInterface-using methods.

patches.name: Strip sensitive permissions
patches.description: Removes selected sensitive permissions from the manifest. Can break features that rely on them; enable only the groups you want stripped.

patches.name: Telemetry / crash-reporter kill
patches.description: Silences analytics, crash-reporting and telemetry SDKs (Firebase, Sentry, Adjust, Mixpanel, Amplitude, Segment, AppMetrica, Bugly, ACRA, etc.).

options.title: Also kill SDK initialization
options.description: Aggressive: no-ops init/activate/start in SDK classes. May break apps that require SDK init to run. Off by default.

patches.name: Universal cleanup
patches.description: Removes junk metadata files and (optionally) strips debug logging calls.

options.title: Strip debug logging
options.description: Remove android.util.Log and Throwable.printStackTrace calls.

options.title: Remove Kotlin module metadata
options.description: Delete META-INF/*.kotlin_module (safe unless the app uses kotlin-reflect).

patches.name: Unlock premium
patches.description: Unlocks Pawxy premium features (VPN servers, removes paywall and upsell badges).
